{{Otheruses|Ubrikkian}}
The '''''Custom Vehicle Division''''' was a part of the large [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] that, on orders, made custom vehicles for most [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lords]] or other important beings.

One such example was the ''Custom Vehicle Division'' making a Sail Barge as ordered by the crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].
